ns2:course.label: Differentiating Music Instruction
ns2:course.description: Strategies for adapting and modifying music instruction for students with disabilities in general, choral, and instrumental music classes. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MUS 240, MUS 342 or MUS 343; or grad standing; or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MUS 240, MUS 342 or MUS 343; or grad standing; or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Senior or Graduate class standing. Restricted to BME:Mus Ed:Choral Music-UIUC, BME:MusEd:Instrmntl Music-UIUC, BME:Mus Ed:Elem Gen Music-UIUC, BME:Mus Ed:Technology -UIUC, BME:Mus Ed:General Music-UIUC, or MME:Music Education -UIUC.
